site.title: DataForSEO single-purpose tools
site.lead: Enter your key once and use it in every tool. The key is stored only in this browser.
key.title: API key
key.unset: Not set (sample is free to view)
key.note: The API password is on the API Access page of your DataForSEO dashboard. It is different from your login password.
err.nokey: Please set your API key first
err.40100: The API key is not valid
err.40210: Insufficient balance. Please top up at DataForSEO
err.40207: DataForSEO is blocking this IP. Remove the IP restriction in your API settings
err.busy: The service is busy. Please wait a moment and try again
err.bad_video: Enter a YouTube video URL or video ID (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…)
err.bad_input: The input is empty. Enter a keyword.
c01.name: See the top search results
c01.desc: Before you write, see which sites already rank
c01.col.title: Title
c01.price: Approx. cost: $0.004 for 10 results, $0.0055 for 20 (rises a little as the count grows). The sample view is free.
c01.eta: Typical for this tool: about 1–1.5 minutes
ui.slow_search: ⓘ Google now routes each search-result link through Google first (for click tracking). Resolving the real URLs takes extra time, so fetching is slower.
c01.title: Top Google Results by Count, Country & Language | Free sample
c01.meta: Check the top Google results (rank, title, URL, domain) for any keyword. Choose how many, plus country and language. Pay per search, about $0.004 for 10 results.
who.freelancer_seo: For freelance web and SEO contractors
site.index_title: DataForSEO single-purpose tools | Try SEO and search data one feature at a time
site.index_meta: Use DataForSEO API features one at a time on screen: search rankings, maps, news and more. Pay only for what you use, with a free sample.
c02.name: See Google AI Mode's answer
c02.desc: Check whether your article is cited in AI Mode
c02.price: Approx. cost: $0.004 per request (about 250 per $1). The sample view is free.
c02.eta: Typical for this tool: about 15 seconds
c02.title: See Google AI Mode's Answer and Its Sources | Free sample
c02.meta: Enter a keyword to see the answer Google's AI Mode returns, plus the title and URL of each cited source. Check whether your article is cited. Pay per request, about $0.004.
c02.col.title: Title
c03.name: See the top places on Google Maps
c03.desc: See where your shop and your competitors rank on the map
c03.price: Approx. cost: about $0.002 for 20–100 results (measured; the same price at any count). The sample view is free.
c03.eta: Typical for this tool: a few seconds
c03.title: Top Places on Google Maps: Rank, Rating, Reviews, Phone | Free sample
c03.meta: Turn a keyword like "dentist Boston" into a list of the top Google Maps results: rank, name, rating, review count, address, phone and website. Save as CSV. About $0.002.
c03.col.title: Name
c04.name: See the "more places" list on the map
c04.desc: See your shop and competitors beyond the top 3 map slots
c04.price: Approx. cost: about $0.002 for 20 results, $0.01 for 100 (measured). Keywords with no results are still charged. The sample view is free.
c04.eta: Typical for this tool: about 2–2.5 minutes
c04.title: Google "More Places" List Beyond the Top 3 | Free sample
c04.meta: See the full "more places" list behind Google's map pack: rank, name, rating, reviews, description, phone and website. Find where you and your competitors stand below the top 3.
c04.col.title: Name
c05.name: See Google News articles
c05.desc: See how your company or industry appears in the news
c05.price: Approx. cost: about $0.002 for 10 results, $0.004 for 20 (adds up per 10). The sample view is free.
c05.eta: Typical for this tool: about 1 minute
c05.title: Google News Articles by Keyword: Source, Date, Title | Free sample
c05.meta: List the Google News articles for a company or industry keyword: source, date, title and URL. See how you appear in the news and save it as CSV. About $0.002 per 10 results.
c05.col.title: Title
c07.name: See top image search results
c07.desc: See what covers and thumbnails look like for a keyword
c07.price: Approx. cost: about $0.002 for 20–100 results (measured; the same price at any count). The sample view is free.
c07.eta: Typical for this tool: about 10 seconds
c07.title: Top Google Image Results for a Keyword | Free sample
c07.meta: See the top Google Images results for a keyword as thumbnails with title and source page URL. Handy for spotting cover and thumbnail trends. Pay per request, about $0.002.
c07.col.title: Title
c08.name: See search-box suggestions
c08.desc: See what readers search for alongside your keyword
c08.price: Approx. cost: about $0.002 per request (about 500 per $1). The sample view is free.
c08.eta: Typical for this tool: about 1–2 seconds
c08.title: Google Search Suggestions by Country & Language | Free sample
c08.meta: Enter a keyword to list Google's search-box suggestions and see what readers look up alongside it. Pay per request, about $0.002. Save as CSV.
c09.name: Find public datasets
c09.desc: Find statistics you can use in an article or book
c09.price: Cost: about $0.002 per search (20 results, about 500 per $1). The sample is free.
c09.title: Find public datasets | Where data on a topic is published (free sample)
c09.meta: Enter a topic and see the name, provider, update date and link of public datasets from Google Dataset Search in a table. For finding sources for articles and books. About $0.002, CSV export.
c09.col.title: Name
c10.name: Find Google Ads advertisers
c10.desc: See whether a competitor runs ads
c10.price: Cost: about $0.002 per search (about 500 per $1). The sample is free.
c10.title: Find Google Ads advertisers | Check if a rival runs ads
c10.meta: Enter a company or shop name and see the advertisers registered with Google: name, ID, country and approximate ad count. For checking if a rival advertises. About $0.002, CSV export.
c10.col.title: Advertiser
c11.name: See running ads
c11.desc: See how a competitor runs ads
c11.price: Cost: about $0.002 per search (40 results, about 500 per $1). The sample is free.
c11.title: See running ads | A domain's ads and run period
c11.meta: Enter a domain and see the ads pointing to it: format, preview image, advertiser, first and last shown dates. For researching how a competitor runs ads. No subscription, about $0.002.
c14.name: See top YouTube search results
c14.desc: See what videos lead a genre
c14.price: Cost: about $0.002 for 20 results, $0.006 for 50, $0.01 for 100 (measured). The sample is free.
c14.title: Top YouTube search results | Views and length by genre
c14.meta: Enter a keyword and see the top YouTube search results: rank, title, channel, views, upload date and length. For researching a genre before you start. No subscription, about $0.002 for 20.
c14.col.title: Title
c15.name: See one video's numbers
c15.desc: Check the numbers of a video that is taking off
c15.price: Cost: about $0.006 per lookup (about 160 per $1). The sample is free.
c15.title: One video's numbers | YouTube views, likes, comments
c15.meta: Enter a YouTube video URL and see title, views, likes, comment count, upload date and description in a table. For logging the numbers of a rising video. No subscription, about $0.006, CSV export.
c15.col.title: Title
c16.name: See a video's comments
c16.desc: Read buyers' real opinions in review-video comments
c16.price: Cost: about $0.002 for 20 comments, $0.01 for 100 (measured). The sample is free.
c16.title: See a video's comments | YouTube comment text and likes
c16.meta: Enter a YouTube video URL and see comments in a table: text, likes, replies and date. For reading real opinions under a product review video. No subscription, about $0.002 for 20, CSV export.
c17.name: Read a video's subtitles in full
c17.desc: Read what a video says as text
c17.price: Cost: about $0.006 per lookup (about 160 per $1). The sample is free.
c17.title: Read video subtitles in full | YouTube subtitles with times
c17.meta: Enter a YouTube video URL and read its subtitles with start times. For reading a video's content as text. Choose Japanese or English. No subscription, about $0.006, CSV export.
c18.name: See ChatGPT's answer
c18.desc: See what ChatGPT says when customers ask
c18.price: Cost: about $0.03 per question (with web search, about 35 per $1). The sample is free.
c18.title: See ChatGPT's answer | What it says and cites when asked (free sample)
c18.meta: Enter a question and see ChatGPT's answer with web search, plus the pages it cites (title and URL). For checking what customers would get. No subscription, about $0.03, CSV export.
c18.prompt: Question (e.g. Recommend 3 ramen shops in Shibuya)
c18.col.title: Cited page title
c19.name: See Claude's answer
c19.desc: See what Claude says when asked
c19.price: Cost: about $0.002 per question (no web search, about 450 per $1). The sample is free.
c19.title: See Claude's answer | What it says when asked, as text (free sample)
c19.meta: Enter a question and see Claude's answer (no web search) as text. For checking what prospects would get. No subscription, about $0.002, CSV export.
c19.prompt: Question (e.g. What are good attendance tools for a small company?)
c20.name: See Gemini's answer
c20.desc: See what Gemini says when asked
c20.price: Cost: about $0.016–0.06 per question (with web search; 3 tests). The sample is free.
c20.title: See Gemini's answer | What it says and cites when asked (free sample)
c20.meta: Enter a question and see Gemini's answer with web search, plus the pages it cites (title and URL). For checking how you look in AI search. No subscription, about $0.016–0.06, CSV export.
c20.prompt: Question (e.g. Recommend 3 popular cafes for lunch in Shibuya)
c20.col.title: Source name
c21.name: See Perplexity's answer
c21.price: Cost: about $0.006 per question (about 170 per $1). The sample is free.
c21.title: See Perplexity's answer | Which sites it cites (free sample)
c21.meta: Enter a question and see Perplexity's answer plus the search results it cites (title and URL). For checking which kinds of sites get cited. No subscription, about $0.006, CSV export.
c21.prompt: Question (e.g. Recommend 3 ramen shops in Shibuya)
c21.col.title: Page title
c22.name: See ChatGPT search
c22.desc: See which products ChatGPT search shows
c22.price: Cost: about $0.004 per search (about 250 per $1). Takes about 30 seconds. The sample is free.
c22.title: See ChatGPT search | Answer, sources and recommended products (free sample)
c22.meta: Enter a keyword and see the ChatGPT search answer, its sources and the recommended products (name, tag, image). For checking which products appear. No subscription, about $0.004, CSV export.
c22.col.title: Source title
c23.name: See how often AI is asked
c23.desc: Check whether a topic is asked of AI often
c23.price: Cost: about $0.01 per keyword (about 99 per $1). The sample is free.
c23.title: See how often AI is asked | Monthly AI search volume and a 12-month trend (free sample)
c23.meta: Enter a keyword and see its monthly AI search volume for the last 12 months. For checking whether a topic is also asked of AI. No subscription, about $0.01, CSV export.
c24.name: See search volume
c24.desc: See how often a keyword is searched each month
c24.price: Cost: $0.09 per call (the same for several keywords, about 11 per $1). The sample is free.
c24.title: See search volume | Monthly volume, CPC, competition and a 12-month trend (free sample)
c24.meta: Enter keywords one per line and see monthly search volume, CPC, competition and the last 12 months in a table. For choosing blog topics. No subscription, $0.09 per call for many keywords, CSV export.
c25.name: Get keyword ideas for a site
c25.desc: Find keyword ideas that fit a client's site
c25.price: Cost: $0.09 per call (about 11 per $1). About 1000 rows come back. The sample is free.
c25.title: Keyword ideas for a site | A domain's ideas with volume and CPC (free sample)
c25.meta: Enter a domain and see keyword ideas related to the site with monthly volume, CPC and competition. For researching a client's site. No subscription, $0.09 per call, CSV export.
c26.name: Find related keywords for ads
c26.desc: Find keywords you could use in ads
c26.price: Cost: $0.09 per call (about 11 per $1). The sample is free.
c26.title: Related keywords for ads | Ideas from one word with volume and CPC (free sample)
c26.meta: Enter one keyword and see related keyword ideas with monthly volume, CPC and competition. For researching words to use in ads. No subscription, $0.09 per call, CSV export.
c29.name: See Google Trends over time
c29.price: Cost: about $0.011 per call (about 90 per $1). The sample is free.
c29.title: See Google Trends over time | Weekly popularity of up to 5 keywords (free sample)
c29.meta: Enter up to 5 keywords and see Google Trends popularity (0–100) for the last year as a weekly table. For timing a topic. No subscription, about $0.011, CSV export.
c30.name: See popularity over time
c30.desc: See whether a genre is rising
c30.price: Cost: about $0.0012 per call (about 800 per $1). The sample is free.
c30.title: See popularity over time | A genre's weekly movement (free sample)
c30.meta: Enter one keyword and see its popularity trend as a weekly table. For checking whether a genre is rising. No subscription, about $0.0012, CSV export.
c31.name: See popularity by prefecture
c31.desc: See in which areas a word is searched
c31.price: Cost: about $0.0024 per call (about 400 per $1). The sample is free.
c31.title: See popularity by prefecture | A keyword by region (free sample)
c31.meta: Enter one keyword and see its popularity by prefecture in a table. For checking where a word is searched. Place names are in English. No subscription, about $0.0024, CSV export.
c32.name: See searchers' age and gender
c32.desc: Know the age group and gender of readers
c32.price: Cost: about $0.0024 per call (about 400 per $1). The sample is free.
c32.title: See searchers' age and gender | Who searches a keyword (free sample)
c32.meta: Enter one keyword and see the age and gender tendencies of people who search it in tables. For picturing your readers. Values are relative to the top group. No subscription, about $0.0024, CSV export.
c33.name: See search volume by country
c33.desc: See which countries search a keyword
c33.price: Cost: about $0.18 per call (about 5 per $1). The sample is free.
c33.title: See search volume by country | Where a keyword is searched, with share (free sample)
c33.meta: Enter one keyword and see search volume and share per country in a table. For choosing where to publish abroad. Countries are ISO codes. No subscription, about $0.18, CSV export.
